page.overview:
Who is Bigbot?

Bigbot was a male pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.

Bigbot appeared in War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha 1, a comic book The issue was written by Charles Soule and illustrated by Steve McNiven.
